name: Lady Arabella Ashbourne
source:
Now a Baroness and a widower, you knew Arabella when she was only little, both running around your family's estate to your nanny's chagrin. With an enthusiasm for society and its mainy foibles, she's promised to help you re-enter the world of the upper classes.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=38963]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
